headline: In ‘The Westies,’ Chris Brancato Expands His ‘Scumbag Universe’ (Again)
context: For his new series, the co-creator of “Narcos” and “Godfather of Harlem” turns his focus to a violent gang of Irish New Yorkers in the early 1980s.
